page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual server instance configured with 32 dedicated vCPUs and 256.0 GB of RAM. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, this KVM-hypervised instance provides a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The processor features 32 physical cores with single-thread execution per core, supported by a cache hierarchy of 32 KB L1d, 1.0 MB L2, and 35 MB L3 cache. It lacks local storage and dedicated GPU hardware, relying on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core processing is relatively weak, as evidenced by bottom 25% scores in stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests, alongside poor single-threaded gzip compression performance. However, multi-core execution scales to average levels, with stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and PassMark CPU tests all placing in the middle 50% tier. Memory bandwidth is also average, delivering 98.84 GB/sec for large-block reads and 48.76 GB/sec for large-block writes.

From a resource density perspective, the instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring substantial memory capacity without demanding top-tier single-threaded CPU performance. The presence of hardware-assisted instruction sets like AVX, AVX-512F, and AES aids cryptographic and vector calculations, though newer extensions like AMX and AVX-512 VNNI are absent. This hardware profile is well-suited for memory-intensive workloads such as database operations, Redis caching, and moderate multi-threaded application serving.
